name: The Coaster
description: The Survivors must leave the safe room, navigate an abnormally long Tunnel of Love and make their way towards the signature attraction: an all-wood roller coaster, appropriately named "The Screaming Oak". To Ellis' delight, the Survivors must "run The Screaming Oak" and survive a prototype gauntlet crescendo event to reach a chapter-ending safe house in a fairground queue-booth.
